# Anoop Sinkaran
Blacktown NSW, Australia • 0406 295 160 • ns.anoop@gmail.com • linkedin.com/in/anoop-sinkaran

## Professional Summary
Seasoned Senior Quality Engineer and AI-driven test automation specialist with over 19 years of experience driving end-to-end software quality strategies across cloud SaaS platforms, native mobile applications, and enterprise microservices architectures. Proven track record of championing self-serve quality enablement, leading QA teams through complex platform migrations, and integrating AI tooling and CI/CD pipelines to accelerate release delivery. Certified Google Cloud Generative AI Leader skilled in embedding quality early in the software development lifecycle using modern web, mobile, and API automation frameworks.

* **Quality Engineering & Practices:** End-to-End Test Strategy, Quality Governance, Defect Triage & Prioritization, Data Integrity Validation, Cross-Functional Release Management, Dual BA/QA Requirements Ownership
* **AI & Innovation Tooling:** Custom Copilot SKILL Creation, Copilot CLI, Generative AI Prompting, Automated PR Review Workflows, AI-Assisted Test Generation
* **Mobile & Web Automation:** Android Espresso, iOS XCUITest, Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, Robolectric, Jetpack Compose, Kotlin

* **Observability & Agile Tools:** Dynatrace, JIRA, Zephyr, TestRail, HP ALM, Agile/Scrum Frameworks
